target.statement: OD-ADVCS achieves 100.0% accuracy (49/49) on Iris-virginica vs Iris-versicolor with one outlier selected, compared to ABOD's 100.0% (49/49).

compute.basis: Iris is tiny (150 points); the MDOD package is pip-installable and the experiment is a simple pairwise cosine similarity computation on a laptop CPU.

title: Outlier Detection Using Vector Cosine Similarity by Adding a Dimension
